tasks.title: Finalize player-first MVP rules and acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Pilot audience and organizers, visibility, formats/capacity, lifecycle, support and acceptance are recorded; specification is ready before behavior changes.

tasks.title: Establish local session contract and server permissions
tasks.acceptance: Preserving local migrations/types and anonymous/two-account tests prove visibility, owner lifecycle rules, duplicate prevention and atomic capacity enforcement.

tasks.title: Implement organizer creation and session management
tasks.acceptance: Eligible organizers create and manage sessions with validation and recoverable errors; non-owners cannot mutate them; no attendance/results are implied.

tasks.title: Implement upcoming session discovery and details
tasks.acceptance: Players find real upcoming opportunities and inspect accurate details; loading/empty/error/retry states and agreed visibility work. Authenticated court viewers see organizer-reported started activity with start time, refreshed lifecycle state and recoverable read failures; push is deferred.

tasks.title: Implement registration and personal upcoming sessions
tasks.acceptance: Join/leave/retry/reopen, cancellation visibility and account switching preserve confirmed account-scoped state; full sessions cannot be overbooked.

tasks.title: Implement assembled-match registration and final-score entry
tasks.acceptance: Assembled matches support guests and linked users, validated organizer-declared final scores and atomic closing; organizer corrections retain history and retries do not duplicate entries; no ranking credit or live scoring.

tasks.title: Verify the complete SPEC-002 local journey
tasks.acceptance: A01-A08 for the SPEC-002 slice have reproducible functional, integrity, permissions and browser/iPhone evidence; remaining fixes and measured limits are explicit. Completing this specification does not close the MVP or authorize another phase; owner instruction and a ready SPEC-003 are required.
